title: CESoETH: allow other PW encapsulations than MEF 8 to be carried
description:
Allow per ECID selection (through 'Decode as') of the PW encapsulation
being carried. MEF 8 by default, or Structure-agnostic TDM over Packet
(SAToP), or Private Line Emulation (PLE).
